components.title: Food and drink
components.sentence: Included in this venue's $16,000 package price for up to 80 guests. Each extra guest is $59.

components.title: Ceremony on site
components.sentence: Holding the ceremony here is included in this venue pricing.

components.title: Package price
components.sentence: An all-inclusive price for the Cold Creek Farm - Essentials All-Inclusive Package: the room plus food and drink for up to 80 guests. No separate food cost is added on top.

components.title: Service charge
components.sentence: Not stated - this venue prices an all-inclusive package. Check the PDF for any service charge on top.

components.title: Sales tax
components.sentence: Sales tax is added on top of everything above. This venue did not state its rate.

components.title: Gratuity
components.sentence: Typically 15-20% on top, and separate from the service charge above. Venues that charge both do not always say so up front.

components.title: What you'd pay this venue, before tax and gratuity
components.sentence: Where this venue has not disclosed a figure, the Georgia average stands in. Tax and gratuity come on top.
components.scope_note: Room, food and drink, ceremony and service charge. This is not your whole wedding - no flowers, photography, music or attire.

provenance.headline: 2 of 3 costs came from this venue, plus their own rental fee

band.sentence: This sits in the middle for Georgia. Plenty of venues cost more, plenty cost less.
